## Repository-Wide Mechanisms

### 1. Automated Code Review — CodeRabbit

[`.coderabbit.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.coderabbit.yaml)

- Profile: `assertive`. Auto-reviews all non-draft PRs targeting `main`. Skips PRs with title keywords `wip` or `draft`.
- **Per-path review instructions** are defined for: `**/*.go`, `**/*.rs`, `charts/**/*.yaml`, `k8s/**/*.yaml`, `{Makefile,Makefile.d/**}`, `**/*.md`, `.github/workflows/**/*.yaml`, `**/Dockerfile`.
- **Tools enabled** within CodeRabbit reviews: `golangci-lint` (config: `.golangci.json`), `markdownlint`, `shellcheck`, `yamllint`, `hadolint`, `buf`, `gitleaks`, `clippy`, `semgrep` (config: `semgrep.yaml`), `checkov`, `trivy`, `languagetool`, `actionlint`, `checkmake`.
- **Path filters exclude** generated files: `*.pb.go`, `*.pb.gw.go`, `*_vtproto.pb.go`, `*.tonic.rs`, `*.serde.rs`, `buf.lock`, `go.sum`, `Cargo.lock`, `versions/**`, `assets/**`.
- Knowledge base: CodeRabbit ingests `**/AGENTS.md`, `**/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `**/README.md`, `**/docs/contributing/*.md` as guidelines.
- Auto-labeling rules configured for: `type/bug`, `type/feature`, `type/refactoring`, `type/dependency`, `type/documentation`, `type/security`, `type/ci`.

**Verification query**: Read `.coderabbit.yaml` at the cutoff and confirm `reviews.auto_review.enabled = true` and `base_branches: ["main"]`.

- Triggered on push to `main`/`release/v*.*` and all PRs, path-scoped to `internal/**`, `pkg/**`, `cmd/**`, `go.mod`, `go.sum`, `Makefile.d/test.mk`.
- Three parallel jobs: `test-cmd`, `test-internal`, `test-pkg`. Each runs `make test/<pkg>/gotestfmt` then formats results with `tparse`.

**Rust unit tests** ([`unit-test-rust.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/unit-test-rust.yaml)):

- Uploads to both **Codecov** (token auth) and **DeepSource** (DSN auth).
- `continue-on-error: true` on the `make coverage` step — coverage failure is non-blocking.
- [Codecov exclusions](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/codecov.yaml): `apis/grpc/**/*.pb.go`, `*.pb.json.go`, Rust proto stubs, Grafana gen files.

**DeepSource** ([`.deepsource.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.deepsource.toml)):

[`format.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/format.yaml)

**FOSSA** ([`fossa.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/fossa.yaml)): license compliance analysis.

**GitGuardian** ([`.gitguardian.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.gitguardian.yaml)): secrets detection in commits.

### 9. Conflict Detection

[`check-conflict.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/check-conflict.yaml):

[`detect-internal-config-changes.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/detect-internal-config-changes.yaml):
- Triggers on changes to `internal/config/**` (excluding `_test.go`).
- Posts a `**[WARNING:INTCFG]**` comment advising that Helm chart changes may be required. Non-blocking.

### 10. ChatOps Permission Model

[`.github/chatops_permissions.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/chatops_permissions.yaml) + [`chatops.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/chatops.yaml)

Role-gated slash commands. Default role for any GitHub user: `contributor` (can `/rebase`, `/label`, `/format`).

| Command | Minimum role required |
|---|---|
| `/label` | contributor |
| `/rebase` | contributor |
| `/format` | contributor |
| `/gen-test` | sig-set / sig-core / sig-sre / sig-lead |
| `/approve` | sig-lead / author / admin |
| `/changelog` | sig-lead / author / admin |

Named users at cutoff: `kpango` (author+admin), `kmrmt` (author+sig-core), `vankichi` (sig-lead+contributor+sig-set+author), `datelier` (contributor+sig-core+author), `Matts966` (contributor+author), `takuyaymd` (contributor), `tayaboo` (contributor).

`/gen-test` runs `make gotests/install && make gotests/gen`, commits with GPG signing (`-S --signoff`), and pushes to the PR branch.

**Verification query**: Read `.github/chatops_permissions.yaml` at cutoff; confirm `roles.contributor.policies` does not include `approve`.

### 11. Backport Automation

[`backport.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/backport.yaml):
- On push to `main` or `release/v*.*`, looks for the merged PR (by SHA) and reads labels prefixed with `actions/backport/`.
- For each backport label, cherry-picks `GITHUB_SHA` onto the target branch, auto-resolving `go.mod`/`go.sum` conflicts with `--theirs`, then opens a new PR titled `Backport PR #N to <branch> for <title>`.

### 12. Automatic Labeling

[`.github/labeler.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/labeler.yaml) + [`labeler.yaml` workflow](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/labeler.yaml):

Separate workflows exist for end-to-end validation beyond unit tests:

[`backport.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/vdaas-vald@d50c5e731dedf7bc9dbe389bd9057c959198ac97/-/blob/.github/workflows/backport.yaml):

## Deterministic Verification Queries (Repository-Wide)

The following are mechanical checks against the cutoff that do not require inference:

1. **Format gate exists**: `check-format-diff` job in `format.yaml` contains `exit 1` on diff — observable by reading lines 139–147 of that file.
2. **golangci-lint `depguard` denies `sync` stdlib**: `.golangci.json` `linters.settings.depguard.rules.main.deny[0].pkg == "sync"`.
3. **Test jobs are path-scoped**: `unit-test.yaml` `on.pull_request.paths` does not include `charts/**` or `k8s/**`.
4. **CodeQL runs nightly**: `codeql-analysis.yml` `on.schedule[0].cron == "0 1 * * *"`.
5. **`/approve` not available to `contributor` role**: `chatops_permissions.yaml` `roles.contributor.policies` list does not contain `approve`.
6. **Semgrep `go.errgroup.external` is `ERROR`**: `semgrep.yaml` rule `go.errgroup.external.severity == "ERROR"`.
7. **gorules enforces getter access on payload types**: `hack/gorules/rules.go` `CheckPayloadObjectAccess` reports on direct field access where receiver implements `payload.Payload`.
8. **Helm schema validation uses live k3d**: `helm-lint.yaml` `lint-values-schema` job applies `ValdRelease` to a k3d cluster, not a mock.
9. **`test-coverage` DeepSource analyzer disabled**: `.deepsource.toml` last `[[analyzers]]` block `name = "test-coverage"`, `enabled = false`.
10. **Backport go.mod conflict resolution**: `backport.yaml` line 99 `git checkout --theirs go.mod go.sum` — automatic, not human-resolved.
